# Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location (`magic-items:amulet-of-proof-against-detection-and-location`)
**Category:** [Wondrous Items](../equipment-categories/wondrous-items.md) | **Rarity:** Uncommon | **Attunement:** Yes

Wondrous Item

While wearing this amulet, you can't be targeted by Divination spells or perceived through magical scrying sensors unless you allow it.
